text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Use a 4px outer ring in #005fcc with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements on dark backgrounds while remaining visible on light ones. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings, but they stay within touch-friendly sizes and don’t clutter small buttons.

name: Reader
text: A 4px ring fails on patterned backgrounds where the white inner ring vanishes. Switch to a 3px #005fcc outer ring with a 1px white inner ring and a 1px black outer ring—this survives most patterns and keeps touch size. Test on a busy background; if contrast still drops, add a 1px black outline around the whole ring.
